image_description: A close-up portrait of a woman wearing a voluminous, curly brown wig styled in a bouffant or beehive fashion. The wig covers the entire scalp and frames the face with thick bangs. The subject is smiling, wearing a black top and a necklace. The background is slightly out of focus, suggesting an indoor setting.

The pendant on the necklace is geometrically nonsensical. It appears to be a fused blob of metal and dark material without a clear chain connection or recognizable shape, indicating a failure in rendering small, intricate objects.
The vertical lines of the shelving unit in the background warp slightly and do not maintain strict parallelism, suggesting minor geometric instability in the background generation.
